jobs.title: Service Manager (Condo)
jobs.description_text:
Job Overview

The Service Manager (Condo) is responsible for the seamless operation, maintenance, and presentation of all building systems within a luxury high-residences. This role is critical to delivering a five-star living experience by ensuring reliability, discretion, and excellence in all engineering services. #weshowup

The Service Manager (Condo) leads the engineering team, oversees complex building systems, manages high-value capital projects, and works closely with property management and the Board of Directors to protect and enhance the asset’s value. This individual is expected to operate at a high level of professionalism, technical expertise, and resident service.

Key Responsibilities

Luxury Building Operations & Resident Experience

  • Ensure all building systems operate at peak efficiency with zero disruption to residents whenever possible.
  • Deliver a “white-glove” level of service—responding promptly, professionally, and discreetly to resident concerns.
  • Maintain immaculate condition and presentation of all mechanical rooms, back-of-house areas, and service corridors.
  • Coordinate work to minimize noise, inconvenience, and visual impact in occupied residences.

Engineering Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing engineering team with a service-first mindset.

jobs.title: Restaurant Operations Manager
jobs.description_text:
Who we are 

At Picnic, we’re reinventing the way employees experience lunch at work. By partnering with top local restaurants and batching hundreds of orders, we make it easy for companies to offer high-quality, individually packed meals, without fees or tips. Our mission is to create a seamless, affordable, and joyful lunch experience that benefits both employees and employers.

 

About the role 

As a Restaurant Operations Manager, you’ll own restaurant supply for San Francisco: find the right restaurants, sign the partner, and make sure they deliver: enough capacity, prepped on time, packaged properly, with menus and photos worth ordering from. That means real ownership and real accountability from day one. You’ll spend time in facilities and restaurants, tasting food and talking to operators.

 

What you’ll do

  • Selection. Selection depth and cuisine coverage are a key KPI. You decide where it comes from: brick-and-mortar partners, standalone restaurants, and CK facility operators (with CK sales). You make sure every hub has real options at the different price tiers.
  • Restaurant performance. Signing, onboarding, launch, and ongoing health. You own the capacity model, drive on-time prep, and make the pause and unpause calls. If a partner’s prep-by times slip in month three, that’s yours to diagnose and fix.

Compensation: $17.00 – $20.00 / hour

Commitment: 20-30 hours/week

 

About Eulerity

At Eulerity, we are building the future of AI-driven marketing automation. Our platform helps franchises and multi-location businesses manage digital advertising at scale using machine learning, automation, and data.

Behind that technology is a Finance team building the financial infrastructure to support a growing company. We are looking for a highly organized, analytical, and detail-oriented Finance Intern to join our New York office and work directly with our Controller.

This is a hands-on role. You will work with real financial data, transactions, reconciliations, client media spend, reporting, and month-end close activities not just administrative tasks or theoretical exercises.

Figure Technology Solutions, Inc. (Nasdaq: FIGR; OPEN: FGRS) is the leading blockchain-native capital marketplace for the origination, funding, sale and trading of tokenized assets. We’re proud to be recognized as one of Forbes’ Top 50 Fintech Companies and CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies.

Figure (NASDAQ: FIGR) is transforming capital markets through blockchain. We’re proving that blockchain isn’t just theory - it’s powering real products used by hundreds of thousands of consumers and institutions.

We’re proud to be recognized as one of Forbes’ Most Innovative Fintech Startups in 2025 and Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies in Finance and Personal Finance.

jobs.description_text:
CMM PROGRAMMER (2ND SHIFT)

Freeform is deploying software-defined, autonomous metal 3D printing factories around the world, bringing the scalability of software to physical production. Our proprietary technology stack leverages advanced sensing, real-time controls, and data-driven learning to produce digitally-verified, flawless parts at unprecedented speed and cost. You’ll also assist in maintaining inspection tools, documenting results, and continuously improving quality workflows. Over time, you’ll have opportunities to learn more advanced metrology tools and inspection methods in our growing lab. If you are detail-oriented and passionate about precision inspection, quality assurance, and continuous improvement, we’d love to hear from you!
